blockers.description: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not in Celery worker OS environment. Worker starts fine and processes parse+chunk tasks, then crashes at generate_metadata with: TypeError: Could not resolve authentication method. Expected one of api_key, auth_token, or credentials to be set.
blockers.workaround: Fix: in metadata_service.py, change `_anthropic = anthropic.Anthropic()` to `_anthropic = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=settings.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)` — pydantic Settings already loads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env via _find_env_file(), so this bypasses the OS env gap. settings is already imported in config.py. Import settings in metadata_service.py.

decisions.decision: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY fix: use explicit api_key=settings.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Anthropic() constructor rather than setting env var in shell
decisions.rationale: pydantic Settings already loads .env correctly; anthropic SDK reads os.environ independently. Explicit constructor arg is more robust and avoids shell-level env var management.
